parchment-cream.$description: Parchment Cream — Page canvas, footer surface, and dominant background — the warm off-white that gives the entire site its editorial, paper-like feel

ink-black.$description: Ink Black — Primary text, all hairline borders, footer ink, and the near-black that forms every structural line on the page

pure-white.$description: Pure White — Product card surfaces, alternating section backgrounds, and high-contrast text on dark or photographic surfaces

iron-gray.$description: Iron Gray — Secondary body text, subdued borders, and the muted text layer that sits between primary ink and background

soft-stone.$description: Soft Stone — Subtle surface differentiation beneath cards and secondary panels — barely warmer than the cream canvas

spezia-semi-mono.$description: The workhorse typeface for body copy, navigation links, card text, list items, and most UI labels. Semi-mono construction gives it a precise, typeset quality that reinforces the editorial identity. 700 weight is used sparingly for emphasis within mono-spaced blocks.

spezia-medium.$description: Headline and display font — the proportional companion to the Semi-Mono, used for the hero wordmark 'WOVEN' and section titles. Single weight keeps the type system disciplined; contrast comes from size and tracking, not weight.

figtree.$description: Small UI utility font for buttons, icon labels, and tight navigation tags. Rounds out the system where a humanist sans feels warmer than the mono family.

spezia-semi-mono-light.$description: Lighter voice for inputs, helper text, and link descriptions — a whisper-weight variation that creates hierarchy without bold.
